REACHRosa’s journey, step by step

Every eligible person screened. Every positive screen brought back on time.

A working model of Remiel Amicura inside a RadNet lung screening program. Follow Rosa Alvarez from the day she is found, through her first scan, to her completed follow-up, through the systems RadNet already runs.

REACHEligible people are found and taken to their first scan: counseling, order, coverage, booking and rides, according to need.
RETURNEvery positive result becomes one tracked loop, with one next action, until the follow-up scan is done.
VERIFYThe right patient and the right prior images, checked by identity and anatomy before anything is attached.
PROVEEvery notice, booking and action is written to a tamper-evident record RadNet can show.
